1.

On 25th June, 2024, this Court had passed an order adjourning this matter to today to enable Mr.
Godbole to take instructions from the Municipal Commissioner.

The Instructions sought were regarding the amount the Municipal Corporation would be in a position to deposit, especially considering that if no deposit is made, interest keeps mounting as per the statutory provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 or the Right to JULY 8, 2024 Laxmi 17 ia 3657-21.doc Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: In the said order, we had also stated that if Mr. Godbole does not get any instructions by today, then we would proceed to hear the Interim Application.

2. Today when the matter is called out, Mr. Godbole has reverted saying that since the amount is rather large, the Municipal Corporation has requested around six to eight weeks for considering whether the Municipal Corporation would be willing to deposit any amount in this Court.
3. Considering that the amount is quite large, we are inclined to adjourn this matter for some time.
However, the request made for six to eight weeks is rather unreasonable.
We, therefore, place the above matter on 5 th August, 2024.
4. We make it clear to the Municipal Commissioner that if the decision is not taken by that date, the matter will not be adjourned any further and the Interim Application will be heard on merits.

5. Stand over to 5th August, 2024 under the same caption.
JULY 8, 2024 Laxmi 17 ia 3657-21.doc 6.
It is needless to clarify that these instructions shall be given without prejudice to the rights and contentions of all parties concerned.
7. This order will be digitally signed by the Private Secretary/ Personal Assistant of this Court.
All concerned will act on production by fax or email of a digitally signed copy of this order.

[ARIF S.
DOCTOR, J.] [B. P. COLABAWALLA, J.]
JULY 8, 2024
